يستلذا (form X)
# يَسْتَلِذَّا (yastaliḏḏā) /jas.ta.lið.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# يُسْتَلَذَّا (yustalaḏḏā) /jus.ta.lað.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
